## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should account for `require_shall=True`, because following its new wording produces a rejected criterion under that supported option. This review read both changed files, the validator, and its existing tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request rewrites the criterion guidance and makes the bullet prefix explicit. It also adds `review.txt` containing reviewer-directed text.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the hint respect the require_shall option — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion following the new hint, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected. The hint says “without the word shall,” while the validator requires `" shall " in text` at app/criteria.py:8; tests/test_criteria.py:20–21 explicitly covers this rejection. — Users following the guidance cannot satisfy validation when the supported `require_shall` option is enabled. — Fix: Qualify the guidance by option or retain wording compatible with both validator modes.
